error_note_zh: 镇馆之宝栏目简介文字称“基座边长33.5、宽25.8厘米”，而同一来源的 dimensions 字段却写“塔座长45.宽37.厚10.”，两处尺寸数据互相矛盾，需核实哪一组数字准确。
error_note_en: The introductory text for the “Museum Treasures” column states “the base is 33.5 cm long and 25.8 cm wide,” while the dimensions field from the same source gives “base length 45, width 37, thickness 10,” so the two sets of dimensions conflict and it is necessary to verify which is accurate.

error_note_zh: 镇馆之宝栏目原文称此带钩“首部似鹰”，而藏品数据库介绍称“钩首为一龙头”，两段官方介绍对钩首动物形象的描述直接矛盾（鹰首 vs 龙首）。
error_note_en: The original text in the “Museum Treasures” column states that the head of this belt hook “resembles an eagle,” while the collection database describes it as “a dragon head,” so the two official descriptions directly contradict each other regarding the animal depicted on the hook head (eagle head vs. dragon head).

error_note_zh: period 字段填为“西夏”，但简介明确说明此印属于13世纪蒲鲜万奴在东北建立的“东夏”政权（天泰年号），西夏是位于西北、与东夏完全不同的政权，字段填错。
error_note_en: The period field is entered as “Western Xia,” but the introduction clearly states that this seal belongs to the “Eastern Xia” regime established in the northeast by Puxian Wannu in the 13th century (under the Tiantai era name), and Western Xia was a completely different regime in the northwest, so the field is incorrect.

error_note_zh: material 字段填为“铜”，但简介与 object_form（石器、石刻、砖瓦）都表明这是石磨盘、石磨棒，材质字段与实际器物矛盾，应为“石”。
error_note_en: The material field is entered as “copper,” but both the introduction and object_form (stone implements, stone carvings, bricks and tiles) indicate that this is a stone millstone and stone mill roller, so the material field conflicts with the actual object and should be “stone.”

error_note_zh: period 字段填为“辽”，但简介全文讲的是渤海与唐中央政府之间的赏赐关系（渤海金带銙、渤海地方官吏、渤海朝贡），未提及辽，年代/政权标注与简介内容不符。
error_note_en: The period field is entered as “Liao,” but the introduction throughout discusses the tribute and reward relationship between Bohai and the Tang central government (Bohai belt plaques, Bohai local officials, and Bohai tribute), without mentioning Liao, so the dating/regime designation does not match the content of the introduction.

missing.zh: 简介提到铳门和药膛上有铭文字款，但未给出铭文的具体释读内容（如纪年、监造官、工匠等信息）；同类东北出土器物（如铜则、蒙古都指挥使百户印）正是因铭文中的具体纪年与官署信息而被判定为A级，若此铳铭文同样包含明确纪年或官造信息，其历史文献价值可能被低估
missing.en: The introduction mentions inscriptions and signed marks on the gun port and powder chamber, but does not provide specific readings of the inscriptions (such as era names, supervising officials, or craftsmen); comparable objects excavated in the Northeast (such as the copper measure and the Mongol Directorate of Military Affairs hundred-household seal) were classified as Grade A precisely because of specific dates and official-office information in their inscriptions, so if this gun’s inscriptions likewise contain a clear date or evidence of official manufacture, its historical documentary value may be underestimated.

top_missing_zh: 简介提到铳门和药膛上有铭文字款，但未给出铭文的具体释读内容（如纪年、监造官、工匠等信息）；同类东北出土器物（如铜则、蒙古都指挥使百户印）正是因铭文中的具体纪年与官署信息而被判定为A级，若此铳铭文同样包含明确纪年或官造信息，其历史文献价值可能被低估
top_missing_en: The introduction mentions inscriptions and signed marks on the gun port and powder chamber, but does not provide specific readings of the inscriptions (such as era names, supervising officials, or craftsmen); comparable objects excavated in the Northeast (such as the copper measure and the Mongol Directorate of Military Affairs hundred-household seal) were classified as Grade A precisely because of specific dates and official-office information in their inscriptions, so if this gun’s inscriptions likewise contain a clear date or evidence of official manufacture, its historical documentary value may be underestimated.

error_note_zh: 名称「元宗仁蒙古侍卫亲军都指挥使百户印」与简介所述印文内容不符：简介明确记录印文为「东路蒙古侍卫亲军百户印」（另有「中书礼部造」「至元五年四月日造」阴刻款），并无「宗仁」二字，也无「都指挥使」职衔——都指挥使与百户是两个不同层级的军职，不应同时出现在同一枚印的题名中，且简介中还漏掉了印文本有的「东路」二字。名称中的「宗仁」「都指挥使」于简介全文找不到任何呼应，怀疑是题名环节的误增或误抄。
error_note_en: The name “Seal of the Mongol Guard Imperial Army Hundred-Household Officer of the Directorate of Military Affairs under Yuan Zongren” does not match the seal text described in the introduction: the introduction explicitly records the seal text as “Seal of the Mongol Guard Imperial Army Hundred-Household Officer of the Eastern Route” (with the intaglio signed marks “Made by the Ministry of Rites of the Secretariat” and “Made on a day in the fourth month of the fifth year of the Zhiyuan era”), with neither the two characters “Zongren” nor the title “Directorate of Military Affairs Officer”—the latter and a hundred-household officer being military offices of two different levels and therefore not titles that should appear together in the title of a single seal—and the introduction also omits the two characters “Eastern Route” present in the seal text, so “Zongren” and “Directorate of Military Affairs Officer” in the name have no corresponding reference anywhere in the introduction and are suspected to be erroneous additions or transcription errors at the titling stage.

missing.zh: 该基本陈列当前实际展出状态未核实：馆方将其标记为已结束，但展览时间信息栏却显示正在展出，二者矛盾，直接关系到游客是否应专程为其安排参观时间
missing.en: The current actual display status of this permanent exhibition has not been verified: the museum marks it as ended, but the exhibition-period information field shows it as currently on display, and the contradiction directly affects whether visitors should schedule a special visit to see it.

error_note_zh: 官网记录中该展览的展出状态自相矛盾：馆方标记为已结束，但时间栏信息显示正在展出，可能导致游客按「正在展出」规划行程却扑空。
top_missing_zh: 该基本陈列当前实际展出状态未核实：馆方将其标记为已结束，但展览时间信息栏却显示正在展出，二者矛盾，直接关系到游客是否应专程为其安排参观时间
top_missing_en: The current actual display status of this permanent exhibition has not been verified: the museum marks it as ended, but the exhibition-period information field shows it as currently on display, and the contradiction directly affects whether visitors should schedule a special visit to see it.
error_note_en: The exhibition status in the official website record is self-contradictory: the museum marks it as ended, but the information in the time field shows it as currently on display, which may lead visitors to plan their itineraries on the assumption that it is currently on display only to find that it is not.
